notes: *is* at t045 goes to the interrogative הֲ as the fronted question auxiliary of a verbless clause (rules 17, 20), and the predicate noun keeps only its own *man*.

The infinitive s040 keeps only the supplied *it should*, its lexeme lost in the ASV's passive recasting, while מָצוֹר carries *be besieged*; the בְּ and its assimilated article are left unrepresented by that recasting (rules 12, 40).
`מִפָּנֶיךָ` fuses preposition and construct noun into the one word *of*, headed on פָּנֶה, with the suffix taking *thee* (rule 30).
